title: Rodrigo Niño (Naples) to Charles V, 19 March 1522, one ciphered paragraph (BNE MSS/20213/27; DECODE R1182)

documents.shelfmark: Biblioteca Nacional de España, MSS/20213/27; DECODE R1182

plaintext.source: No decipherment on the leaf or on DECODE.

transcription.notes: 8 cipher lines on f. 1v; signs are about 12 px high and several pairs cannot be told apart reliably.

system.summary: Letter substitution in graphic signs with word spaces, and syllable-shaped nulls (mer, mor, pu, por) per Kolosova's Cifra 15; a double-barred cross sign follows many signs.
system.sibling_key: Lope Hurtado 1522 key (lopehurtado/key_codes.tsv) compared by eye: different system

prior_solution.where: Kolosova 2017 thesis (Cifra 15, pp. 452-459) and 2024 book, via Tomokiyo cryptiana spanish2C; key not seen here; not confirmed that this letter is one of her three

conditions.human_role: Selected the target; the DECODE session cookie was supplied earlier.

solution.what: Fetched DECODE metadata and images P1-P2 of R1182 with the saved cookie.
Viewed the images: the letter is clear Spanish except one 8-line ciphered paragraph on f. 1v, opening [mer] and closing [mer por].
Tomokiyo spanish2C: Kolosova's Ko.15 (Rodrigo Niño 1522) is a simple substitution with nulls mer/mor/pu/por, which matches this block.
Fetched Kolosova's thesis from RODERIC (hdl 10550/66216): a 148-page version with no Niño chapter; the 2024 Salamanca book is paid.
Eye transcription of the 8 lines into ASCII sign codes (cipher_p2.txt), 128 words.

Simulated annealing with es-golden-age 5-grams, max two signs per letter; variants dropping '#' and/or 'o' as nulls and merging '#' into the preceding sign. Best -2.9 to -3.5 per char (Spanish about -1.1), unreadable.

outcome.method_basis: The one ciphered paragraph of R1182 (8 lines, 336 signs) was eye-transcribed and attacked ciphertext-only without convergence; Kolosova's printed key for Nino's cipher (Cifra 15) could not be obtained.
outcome.notes: Skipped. Closed as attempted. The system is in print (Kolosova, Cifra 15), but the key was not reachable here and a blind attack on 336 doubtful signs with unresolved nulls did not converge.
